title: ErrorOutput
description: Output of a failed `--json` command, on stdout; the exit code is not 0.

code.description: Stable machine code in English, such as unknown_command. The list is open: a client shows an unknown code as a generic error with its message.

message.description: The reason, in the operator's language.

hint.description: What to do for the action to succeed, in the operator's language.

details.description: Parameters of the error, such as command and flag, for a client to build its own text.
